property_summary: For every call to transfer(from, caddress, _tos, v), the reference contract always reverts when _tos is empty (i.e., it never succeeds for _tos.length == 0); the mutant instead allows empty _tos (when v>0) so there exist inputs with empty _tos where the mutant returns true but the reference would revert.
change_summary: Change the require that ensures _tos.length > 0 to instead require v > 0, so calls with empty _tos no longer revert but calls with v==0 do.
